episodes.text: Go straight down the corridor and stop before the red marker.
Move along the corridor to the red marker, then stop.
Continue forward until you reach the red marker.
Navigate to the red marker at the end of the corridor.
At the junction turn left and stop near the red marker.
At the junction turn right and stop near the blue marker.
Find the red marker on the left side of the junction.
Find the blue marker on the right side of the junction.
Go around the blocks and stop at the red marker.
Navigate past both obstacles to the red marker.
Avoid the two blocks and finish by the red marker.
Travel through the obstacles toward the red marker and stop.
